node.statement: Likewise, no bijectivity conclusion is inferred from node 1.9. The root qualifies all four map conclusions by "under the respective producer hypotheses" and describes u_3 as furnished by lem-maincb-stage3-call-envelope with lem-maincb-stage3-raw-merge. For this Stage-3 composite producer, the respective hypotheses are the conjunction of the call-envelope hypotheses and the raw-merge hypotheses. Hence they explicitly include that B_U and B_V are finite-dimensional C*-algebras, A_R is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra, and the four fixed level-one corner maps of the datum are bijective. Node 1.9 supplies the remaining raw-merge premises: the explicit datum furnished by lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum, epsilon_R<=t, rho<=C_cross^0*t, and 0<=t<=W.e_cross; node 1.3 supplies W.e_cross<=min{e_cross^0,e_3}.
